# truenas_snapshot_hold (Action)

Places a hold on a snapshot (pool.snapshot.hold). A held snapshot cannot be deleted until released.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot` (String) Snapshot to hold, e.g. "tank/data@snap1".

### Optional

- `recursive` (Boolean) Also hold the equivalent snapshot on descendant datasets.
